ov: The ring-tailed lemur is the best-known lemur, with a long black-and-white ringed tail. Like all lemurs it lives wild only on Madagascar, in troops of up to 30 led by females.

why.et: Ring-tailed lemurs are hunted locally for bushmeat, one reason they’re endangered.

rg: Southern Madagascar, from gallery forest to spiny scrub.
fx: It is the most ground-dwelling of all living lemurs.
